Field log, day six. Written by Yash, survey lead.
Aadhya, our twenty-year-old intern, got the camera-trap sheet for Grid 4 yesterday: forty cameras, three weeks of images to sort. Monday
First week of my first real lab project. Protein extraction. I had no idea where to start.
My instinct was to fake it. Nod in the meeting, look busy, search everything online at midnight. Or wait for someone to notice I was lost.
Instead I went to Lalit, the PhD senior, and said, "I don't know how to plan this. Can you show me how you'd break it down?" He drew a five-step outline on a napkin: question, method, controls, timeline, what could go wrong.
I spent three days working through it alone. Messed up the controls twice.
Today I went back with a list: "Why do we use this buffer? What if the sample degrades overnight?" Lalit grinned. "Good questions. Better than last week."
Felt proud. And less like a fraud.
– Sabina
